description: Rewrite a rough idea in any language into a ready-to-paste prompt for Veo 3.1, Nano Banana, Midjourney, Kling, ChatGPT or Claude, with two variations and a note. Video/image prompt bodies are in English; dialogue and on-screen text stay in the user's language. ChatGPT/Claude prompts stay in the user's language. Set own_language to true to write the whole prompt in that language. Uses the same limits, spend cap and moderation as the web: daily free allowance first, then 4 credits per paid prompt. Does not generate images or video.

idea.description: Your rough idea in any language or dialect.

own_language.description: Write the entire prompt in your language, including for image/video targets (default false).

target.description: The model you will paste the prompt into.

name: improve_prompt
title: Improve a prompt (free allowance, then 4 credits)
